addendum_content_raw:
VIL Investments and Trusts 2.

The Ameriprise Insured Money Market Account was established on 08/08/2012 to pay by check for major renovations to our residence during 2012 and 2013.

Checks drawn on the account bear the following identifier: "Ameriprise ONE Financial Account. Upon completion of the renovation project in October

2013, the Ameriprise Insured Money Market Account was closed on 10/28/2013 and the remaining proceeds were deposited into my Black Hills Federal Credit

Union checking account on 11/04/2013 in the sum of $5,156.13. Total interest earnings on the Ameriprise Insured Money Market Account from its opening on

08/08/2012 to closure of the account on 1028/2013 totaled less than $1,000.
